title: Property Campaign Analysis
topic: Interpreting a fictional property campaign: viewing conversion and matching listings to explicit buyer constraints

questions.question: In a hypothetical scenario, a property campaign had 500 total website visits and resulted in 25 viewing appointments. What is the conversion rate of visits to viewing appointments?
questions.explanation: The conversion rate is calculated by dividing 25 appointments by 500 visits.
questions.question_id: Dalam skenario hipotetis, sebuah kampanye properti memiliki 500 total kunjungan situs web dan menghasilkan 25 janji temu kunjungan. Berapakah tingkat konversi kunjungan menjadi janji temu kunjungan?
questions.explanation_id: Tingkat konversi dihitung dengan membagi 25 janji temu dengan 500 kunjungan.

questions.question: A buyer requires a property with exactly 3 bedrooms, a swimming pool, and a price under Rp 5.000.000.000. Which listing matches every constraint?
options: Listing C: 3 bedrooms, swimming pool, Rp 4.900.000.000
Listing B: 3 bedrooms, no pool, Rp 4.800.000.000
Listing A: 2 bedrooms, swimming pool, Rp 4.500.000.000
Listing D: 4 bedrooms, swimming pool, Rp 4.700.000.000
questions.explanation: Listing C is the only option that meets the bedroom count, pool requirement, and price cap.
questions.question_id: Seorang pembeli membutuhkan properti dengan tepat 3 kamar tidur, kolam renang, dan harga di bawah Rp 5.000.000.000. Listing mana yang memenuhi setiap batasan?
options_id: Listing C: 3 kamar tidur, kolam renang, Rp 4.900.000.000
Listing B: 3 kamar tidur, tanpa kolam, Rp 4.800.000.000
Listing A: 2 kamar tidur, kolam renang, Rp 4.500.000.000
Listing D: 4 kamar tidur, kolam renang, Rp 4.700.000.000
questions.explanation_id: Listing C adalah satu-satunya pilihan yang memenuhi jumlah kamar tidur, persyaratan kolam renang, dan batas harga.

verification.method: Streamlit AppTest with real local-model API calls; no model stub
verification.answer_selection: One correct and one deliberately wrong answer selected programmatically.
